question: What initial yogic practice begins the sequence of signs described to the beloved?
premises: The practice begins with the first stage
The root wheel is the object of practice
The beloved is addressed at the time of practice
inference: When one first practices the root wheel, the initial stage begins.
uncertainties: yadānyabhyasate is a fused sandhi form analyzed as given
plain_english: O beloved, when one first practices the root wheel.
